claims.disproof_condition: 條件：CFL 或其母公司一手寫出 DoubleThin 停產或退出封裝基板；核查頻率：每年（CFL 官網型錄、母公司年報）。觸發後 48 小時：e1 降 confidence。
claims.statement: Defu Technology's 2025-09 share-issuance plan (then a prospective acquirer of Circuit Foil Luxembourg, so an interested party): DTH (DoubleThin) is Circuit Foil Luxembourg's carrier copper foil brand — a two-layer structure whose ultra-thin layer is supported by a peelable carrier — and 'HVLP3 and DTH products are in mass production for products of top international manufacturers'. Customers not named; the acquisition was reportedly terminated in 2026-01 (media only, not traced).
